text: BAM share rose 0.38 percentage points over 23 hours and 1.37 percentage points over 7 days, to 34.2% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 63 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not broad validator churn.
